# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman with fair, lovely curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears her sleeves with puffs larger than anyone else in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, broadminded, and tactful teacher who possesses a gift for winning her pupils' affections. She is an inspiring educator who encourages students to think, explore, and discover independently rather than sticking strictly to beaten paths. She also holds high standards, urging her pupils to write simply and become their own severest critics.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## Traits

- Bright and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Tactful and broadminded  <sub>[v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>
- Encouraging and inspiring  <sub>[v1 c24 P5](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0005), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching and explaining complex subjects clearly  <sub>[v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008)</sub>
- Winning the affection and bringing out the best in her pupils  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To prepare her advanced students to pass the entrance examination for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is hired as the new teacher for Avonlea school, becoming the community's first female teacher. She quickly earns the adoration of her pupils by introducing engaging activities such as physical culture exercises, field days for nature study, and Friday afternoon recitations and dialogues. In November, she organizes a student concert in the hall to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. She also organizes an advanced class for students intending to prepare for the Queen's Academy entrance examination, giving them extra lessons for an hour after school. Although offered a position in her home district's grade school at the end of the year, she chooses to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their entrance exams.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- Hired as the first female teacher in Avonlea
- Struggled with geometry herself when she was younger
- Was offered a teaching position in her home district's grade school, but declined it to stay in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
